spec.description: Boomi runtime OTel (metrics + traces) via Alloy. Filter by runtime (service.name) and node. Source: observability-eks/dashboards/

spec.title: TPS (completed root spans/s, last)
spec.description: Root spans (no parent) completed per second — one per inbound transaction. Reuses the TPS graph's query result (-- Dashboard -- datasource), so it adds no Tempo load.

spec.title: GC time — % of wall-clock spent in GC
JVM CPU — cores used (dashed = available cores)
spec.description: jvm_cpu_count is only reported intermittently by the runtime, so capacity is the max seen in the last 24h and may be absent.

spec.title: Platform messaging — deliveries & failures per second
Platform messaging — pending uploads by queue
Throughput — completed root spans per second (TPS)
Root span duration — p50 / p95 / p99
Failures per second — failed executions & error spans
Span duration by step — boxplot (ordered by step id, labelled with userLabel)
spec.description: Every span carrying processStep.id, over the selected time range. Box = p25–p75, line = median, whiskers = p5–p95. Rows are ordered by process, then step number (shape2 before shape10). Steps with no userLabel show the step type. Hover a box for exact values and span count.

spec.query: {span.processStep.id != nil && resource.service.name =~ "${service:regex}"} | quantile_over_time(duration, .05, .25, .5, .75, .95) by (span.process.id, span.processStep.id, span.processStep.userLabel, name)
